## What problem does this solve?
<!-- Real problem, not a hypothetical one. Who is hitting it, in what context. -->

## Describe the solution
<!-- Concrete. API shape, behaviour, error cases. -->

## Alternatives considered
<!-- What did you look at first, and why this one. -->

## Implementation notes
<!-- Optional. Where in the crate, what crates to lean on, any constraints. -->

## Are you willing to PR this?
<!-- "Yes / No / Maybe with guidance". A "yes" moves the issue up the queue. -->
